description: Managed Harmos project hooks installed by stkr.

hooks.command: uv run --locked --quiet --project tools/python python .stkr/commands.py --optional project hook post
uv run --locked --quiet --project tools/python python .stkr/commands.py --optional project hook pre
uv run --locked --quiet --project tools/python python .stkr/commands.py --optional project hook start
uv run --locked --quiet --project tools/python python .stkr/commands.py --optional project hook stop
